Landlord Reference Guide
Your Termination Notice Checklist
Your property manager has started a termination notice. This guide shows you exactly what to do — step by step. Works on your phone or computer.
You may have received a link by SMS or email. Both take you to the same form — the steps below are identical whether you open it on your phone or computer.
Select the workflow
Workflow with a Written Statement
ℹ
No documents to upload. Complete the form, confirm the details and sign — that is all that is required.
1
Open the link from your SMS or email
From: REI Forms Live · no-reply@reiformslive.com.au
▾
SMS link (left) and email (right) — both open the same form

You will receive an SMS with a link or an email from no-reply@reiformslive.com.au — or both. Tap or click the link. No login or account is needed.

⚠
Can't find the email? Check spam/junk. The sender domain is reiformslive.com.au. If you received an SMS, tap the link in that message.
2
Click Get Started
REI Forms Live welcome page
▾
Welcome page — mobile (left) and desktop (right)

A welcome page explains the process. Click Get Started to begin.

ClickGet Started
3
Review the form and complete the Written Statement
Check pre-filled details, tick Yes and complete the written statement
▾
Landlord Termination Confirmation — mobile (left) and desktop (right)

The form is pre-filled with Landlord, Tenant, Premises and Agent details. Check these are correct then scroll to the Written Statement section.

Written Statement — tick Yes and complete the written statement, mobile (left) and desktop (right)
  • Tick Yes to confirm the relevant person will reside at the premises for at least 6 months
  • In the text box, complete the written statement as required.
⚠
Be specific. Provide all required details in the written statement — incomplete responses may delay the process.

Use the Save button if you need to return to the form later.

4
Click Complete and confirm
Locks the form — cannot be edited after this
▾
Complete Request dialog — mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Complete (top right). A dialog warns you to ensure documents are uploaded — for this workflow there is nothing to upload, so click Yes, Complete.

ℹ
The upload reminder is a general message shown for all workflows. For a Written Statement there are no documents to upload — go ahead and click Yes, Complete.
ClickYes, Complete
5
You are redirected to Forms Live Sign
Automatic — happens in a few seconds
▾
Request Completed — redirecting to signing, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Request Completed confirms the form is submitted and documents are ready for signing. You will be redirected automatically. If not, tap the view the signing request link on screen.

6
Sign the document
Forms Live Sign — electronic signature
▾
Forms Live Sign intro — click Get Started, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Get Started on the signing pop-up.

Click the Start tab, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click the Start tab to navigate to the first signature field.

Click Sign Here, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Sign Here.

Your Signature dialog — Standard or Draw, then Adopt Signature, mobile (left) and desktop (right)
  • Choose Standard (auto-generated from your name) or Draw your own
  • Confirm your full name and click Adopt Signature
ClickAdopt Signature
7
Click Complete — you're done
Your property manager is notified automatically
▾
Nearly Finished — click Complete, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Complete in the Review & Complete dialog.

Document Signing Complete — mobile (left) and desktop (right)
✓
All done! Your property manager has been notified automatically. Tap Download Document to save a copy for your records if you wish.
Workflow with an Upload Request
⚠
You may be asked to upload supporting documents (e.g. a copy of the contract for sale). Your property manager may handle this for you instead — they will let you know. If so, simply click Close when the upload prompt appears.
1
Open the link from your SMS or email
From: REI Forms Live · no-reply@reiformslive.com.au
▾
SMS link (left) and email (right) — both open the same form

Tap or click the link. No login required.

⚠
Can't find the email? Check spam/junk. Sender is reiformslive.com.au. Use the SMS link if you have it.
2
Click Get Started
REI Forms Live welcome page
▾
Welcome page — mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Get Started to open the form.

ClickGet Started
3
Upload documents — OR click Close
This is where the two paths differ
▾
Upload Documents dialog — Choose File and Upload, OR click Close, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

An Upload Documents dialog appears immediately listing the documents requested (e.g. Copy of Contract, Solicitor/Conveyancer Statement).

📎
If your property manager asked you to upload:
Click Choose File, select the file, give it a name, then click Upload. Wait for the confirmation before continuing.
OR — If your agent said they will handle it
Simply click Close. Your property manager will upload the required documents on your behalf. They will have contacted you before sending the request to confirm this.
ℹ
Not sure which applies? Contact your property manager before proceeding.
4
Review the form and click Complete
Landlord Termination Confirmation form
▾
Landlord Termination Confirmation — Actual Sale of Premises, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

The form shows pre-filled details. Scroll through to review, then click Complete in the top-right corner.

Complete Request dialog — mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Yes, Complete to lock and submit.

ClickYes, Complete
5
You are redirected to Forms Live Sign
Automatic redirect
▾
Request Completed — redirecting to signing, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

The Request Completed screen confirms the form was submitted. You will be redirected to signing automatically.

6
Sign the document
Forms Live Sign — electronic signature
▾
Forms Live Sign intro — click Get Started, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Get Started.

Click the Start tab, mobile (left) and desktop (right)
Click Sign Here, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Start, scroll to Sign Here.

Your Signature dialog — Standard or Draw, then Adopt Signature, mobile (left) and desktop (right)
  • Choose Standard or Draw, confirm your name, click Adopt Signature
ClickAdopt Signature
7
Click Complete — you're done
Your property manager is notified automatically
▾
Nearly Finished — click Complete, mobile (left) and desktop (right)

Click Complete in the Review & Complete dialog.

Document Signing Complete — mobile (left) and desktop (right)
✓
All done! Your property manager has been notified. Tap Download Document if you want a copy for your records.
